title: Turkey Fajita Sheet Pan Eggs
description: A make-ahead sheet pan egg bake with fajita-spiced lean ground turkey, peppers, onion and spinach, cut into squares for breakfasts or dinners all week.

components.amount: 1/2 whole egg + 90 ml (6 tbsp) egg whites

ingredients: 5 frozen spinach balls (1 oz / 28g each, about 140g total)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Line an 18×13-inch half-sheet pan with parchment, letting it come up the sides.
Thaw the 5 frozen spinach balls (about 140g) in a bowl in the microwave for 30–60 seconds, then squeeze out as much water as possible with your hands or a clean tea towel.

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high with no oil. Add the 450g ground turkey and cook, breaking it into small crumbles, until browned and the internal temperature reaches 74°C/165°F, about 7–8 minutes.

Add 1/4 cup water, 1 tsp garlic salt, and the spice mix: 1 1/2 tsp chili powder, 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1 1/2 tsp onion powder, 3/4 tsp crushed red pepper flakes, 3/4 tsp dried oregano, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 1/4 tsp ground cumin, 3/4 tsp sea salt, 3/4 tsp black pepper, 1/8 tsp cinnamon, and 1/8 tsp ground cloves. Stir to coat and cook until the water has fully evaporated, about 2 minutes.

Add the 1 diced onion (about 110g) and 1 diced bell pepper (about 160g) to the skillet and cook until softened, about 4 minutes. Stir in the 140g squeezed spinach and cook 1–2 minutes, breaking up clumps and cooking off any remaining moisture.
In a large bowl, whisk the 4 eggs, 3 cups (720 ml) liquid egg whites, and 1/4 tsp black pepper until smooth with no streaks of white. Do not add salt; the turkey carries enough for the whole pan.
Spread the turkey and vegetable mixture evenly across the lined pan, then pour the egg mixture over the top, nudging the fillings so they're evenly distributed.
Bake for 20–24 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through, until the center is just set and no longer jiggles. Start checking at 20 minutes, since egg-white-heavy bakes turn rubbery quickly.
Let rest for 5 minutes to firm up, then cut into 8 squares.
notes: Protein density: about 13g per 100 kcal. For a leaner pan, use 2 large eggs and 3 1/2 cups (840 ml) liquid egg whites instead of 4 eggs and 3 cups; each square comes to about 182 calories, 25g protein and 6.5g fat (13.8g per 100 kcal). Swapping in 450g extra-lean ground turkey or chicken breast (cooked in 1 tsp canola oil) brings each square to about 176 calories, 28g protein and 4.4g fat (about 16g per 100 kcal). For a cheesy version, scatter 1/2 cup (56g) shredded Monterey Jack over the top before baking; that adds about 26 calories, 1.7g protein and 2g fat per square. To serve, top each square with 1 tbsp diced Roma tomato, 1 tbsp 0% plain Greek yogurt, and a squeeze of lime (about 1 tsp lime juice, or 1/6 of a lime); these toppings are not included in the macros. For more heat, add 1 seeded, minced jalapeño with the onion. Baked squares keep 3–4 days in the fridge or 2–3 months frozen, wrapped individually; microwave 45–60 seconds from chilled or 1.5–2 minutes from frozen.
